prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Polonium (Po) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: her own room in a house of her element's kingdom, its walls and furniture built from the element's materials and colours, a mirror and a window
Light direction: a pool of light from above, the surroundings dimmer.
Outfit: a light linen lounge set — in one bright, saturated colour such as cherry red, cobalt blue, sunflower yellow or kelly green; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body facing the camera; head turned to the side; camera at her eye level; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a book closed against her chest; it is all she holds.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: she looks toward the left of the frame.
EXPRESSION: slightly furrowed brow, softened eyes, lips lightly pressed together.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — polonium: a rare silvery metal found in July 1898 by a husband-and-wife pair of chemists in pitchblende and named for Poland, the wife's homeland then erased from the map, so the world would not forget it; so fiercely radioactive that a small piece heats itself to hundreds of degrees and makes the air around it glow blue; polonium-210 lasts only 138 days before decaying into quiet lead; it once kept a rover warm through the long lunar night — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite, small-framed — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

observations: 1024x1536 verified; one main adult woman; painterly anime finish.
Seated holding a book, other hand on knee, connected limbs and both feet visible.
Planned linen lounge set appears as a crimson lace camisole and shorts, with a chair instead of a bench.
qa.cause: Documented composition/costume/text deviation from the submitted prompt; original generated image retained without regeneration.
